notes.title: Update Roadmap!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey all! [/h2]

It's now been a little over a month since [b]Rooftops & Alleys 1.0[/b] launched across platforms! I want to take a second to thank you all, everyone who supported the game during [b]Early Access[/b], and beyond [b]1.0[/b] so far! I am so proud of the community we have build together!

In the official Discord alone, we now have over [b]40.000 members[/b] - that's crazy!

Today I want to take some time and share with you my plans for the future of [b]Rooftops & Alleys[/b] via a nice little visual [b]roadmap [/b]here.

[h1]The Roadmap[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781966/aff75adb7bd1d2036ae43bd9c49bd2f3546c631a.jpg[/img]

[h1]More Details[/h1]

This roadmap outlines the core top-level features I plan to bring to [b]Rooftops & Alleys[/b] moving forward. Production for Phase 1 already started, with the [b]Replay Editor[/b] having just launched in BETA on Steam yesterday for players to test and share their feedback on! More details about each phase and what it contains in detail will be shared as we move forward in production! Throughout the coming months, you will see new content and features drop on both PC & consoles.

As always, you'll see me regularly hang out in the [b]Discord [/b]to chat with you all, and collect your ideas and feedback! I am super excited for the future of [b]Rooftops & Alleys[/b], and hope the [b]roadmap[/b] gets you excited for what's to come moving forward!

[b]See you soon,
Michel (Dev)[/b]

notes.title: #2 - Post Launch Patch!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed roll saved and executed on next jump if landed from a 360 reverse vault into a precision Landing
[*] Removed sliding head trace to make sliding easier (More like before the sliding update)
[*] Updated K&M inputs for Gainers (Now using the key 'G' instead of Spacebar)
[*] Updated K&M controls for Gainers in the controls UI
[*] Fixed not being able to respawn while hopping/climbing on a vaultable wall
[*] Fixed not being able to respawn while hanging on a ledge occasionally
[*] Fixed cinematic mode triggering for host in CTF/Tag/TB in specific cases (This should fix the cinematic bug FOR GOOD)
[/list]

As always, feel free to come join the [b]official Discord server[/b] to leave your feedback and ideas! I'll make sure to host another dev stage soon so you get a chance to chat to me directly about your questions about anything and everything! :)

[b]Note:[/b] Console players will see the same update as well as some specific console version fixes next week!

See you soon!
Michel (Dev)

notes.title: #1 - Post Launch Patch
notes.notes:
[h3]1.1 Patch Notes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Update of jump charge to make it frame rate independent (it would take twice the time to jump at 50 fps than at 100 fps)
[*] Added scroll for player names that are too long to be displayed
[*] Some crash fixes
[*] Light multiplayer fixes
[*] Added a level loading popup that prevents players from navigating menus after starting to load a new map
[*] Roll jump bug fix
[*] Reduced head hitbox on slide to make it easier
[*] Some localization fixes
[*] Localized COMBO in HUD
[*] Localized Version text in main menu
[*] Fixed a pillar where players got stuck on ContainerShip
[*] Updated Italian localization
[*] Fixed the Cinematic mode being triggered for the Host when a player tried to join a CTF, Tag or Tricks Battle session already in play.
[*] Fixed language initialisation before engagement screen
[*] Added Chinese localization - 现已支持简体中文。
[/list]


[b]Note:[/b] Rest assured I am keeping connected with the community, read reviews, and bug reports in the Discord server so I'm working hard on bringing many more improvements to the game, some of which take longer than others - but expect more news and updates on that soon 🙂

As always, should you encounter any bugs, make sure to join the official Rooftops & Alleys Discord server to report anything you find! Thank you all for being constructive and helpful!

[b]See you soon,
Michel (Dev)[/b]

notes.title: #23 - Tricks & Fluidity Update, & More!
notes.notes:
[b]New Tricks:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added new 360 Frontflip air trick
[*] (‘Y’, Triangle, or ‘R’ + left stick right/Mouse right)
[*] Added new 360 Gainer (Gainer Full) air trick
[*] (‘A’, ‘X’, or ‘Spacebar’ + left stick left/Mouse left)
[/list]

[b]Fluidity Upgrade:[/b]

[list]
[*] New continues tricks system for smoother repeated tricks
[*] (Continues frontflips, 360s, side flips, vortex - WIP)
[*] New and improved 360 spin animation
[*] Improved animation transitions in certain areas
[/list]

[b]Note:[/b] The new continuous tricks system allows for smoother trick
transitions when repeating the same trick multiple times. It allows
for smoother rotation and won’t restart a trick animation every time
It’s performed!

[b]New Camera Setting:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added new camera position settings in gameplay settings
[*] (Left camera/Center camera option for third person)
[/list]

[b]Save Game Fix:[/b]

There was a recent issue which caused the game to freeze once entering the start menu in certain cases. This was due to corrupted save files. A new system has been implemented now to detect corrupted save game files and create new ones to bypass this issue moving forward. Should you ever encounter a similar issue again, or find out why your save game was corrupted (Due to mods for example) please let me know in the Discord :)

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed not being able to slide while tagging/pushing players in TAG
[*] Fixed character occasionally keeps moving left/right on ledge (controller)
[*] Fixed a bug that didn’t let you spawn to certain markers set by the pigeon
[*] Fixed an IK bug that caused weird foot placement on poles
[*] Fixed a bug allowing hosts to enable slow-motion
[*] (if the slow-motion setting was set to ‘toggled’)
[*] Fixed ‘Welcome Back’ font in the main menu
[*] (It wasn’t showing special characters correctly)
[*] Fixed a checkpoint not registering consistently (Steel Trial 5)
[*] The engagement screen now only shows on the initial game launch
[*] (Not every time you go back to the main menu)
[*] Fixed some climbing/hanging bugs
[/list]

notes.title: #17 - Bug Fixes & More!
notes.notes:
[b]Added / Improvements:[/b]

- Improved scrolling experience in the ‘Invite Friends’ online section
(Mouse & Keyboard)
- Improved getting up mechanic after falling/ragdoll
(Should now not cause unintended backflips when pressing
multiple times)
- Added new/improved character shader
(Similar as before but better for performance on low-end specs)
- Improved level bounds in ‘School District’
- Added new Blue Jeans shader to the upper body customization

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

- Fixed a bug where a TAG session became visible to the public
when someone left during the match causing other people to see it and
try to join, therefore getting kicked back to the start menu
- Fixed another bug showing 4/4 sessions

[b]Important Notes:[/b]

This shader update will likely reset your character customization so just update it to what you want again once launching the game :)

As modding is not officially supported yet some mods may cause problems
with the multiplayer update. Should you get a ‘fatal error’, invisible clothing, or
have issues launching the game please make sure to check your mods
(Remove them/back them up until they get updated)
